title: Unobtainable Crafting
description: Adds crafting recipes for items that seem like they should be craftable but aren't
body:
This Mod Adds recipies for many items that dont have crafting recipies that I thought should have one, so now they do! Includes normal vanilla items, command only items and even 2 new blocks that have textures in the files but no offical block not even a command
